messages:
marta: Quick thread  proposal: two-mode Dedicated fallback policy (soft = local quantized, hard = regional shared). Goal: reduce customer cost spikes while keeping SLA clarity. Thoughts?

kevin: Soft sounds doable  kernel switch + model artifact. Hard needs routing + residency checks.

ajay: Ops: default to soft for stateful routes. Hard only for stateless or explicit opt-in.

rachel: Oncall asks: telemetry for fallback_rate, p99_latency_delta, and multi-turn failure rate. Alert when hard-fallback >5% for 5m.

sam: Sales: customers want per-route control and explicit billing. We should expose allow_soft/allow_hard per-tenant and show cost impact in UI.

nina: Billing: create meters fallback.soft_minutes and fallback.hard_minutes and surface estimated cost in console. Contract must require opt-in for hard.

marta: Launch checklist draft:
- telemetry + dashboards
- residency gating enforced
- pilot with 3 customers (2 SMB, 1 mid-market)
- regression on eval set <=8% p99 quality delta
- visible invoice line for fallback usage
- runbook and staging saturation test

kevin: Prototype plan: 1 sprint for quantized variant + perf numbers, 1 sprint for control-plane policy + console, then pilot.

ajay: Prewarm idea: paid mini-KV pin for tenants that opt into hard-fallback to reduce session loss. Ops will prototype.

rachel: I'll draft the runbook and saturation-replay test. Must verify rollback under 3 minutes.

marta: Owners: kevin(runtime), ajay(control-plane), nina(billing), rachel(oncall), sam(customer recruitment). I'll write RFC and schedule 30m review.

sam: Recruiting pilots now. Will DM names.

marta: Thanks, team. Post any objections on the RFC PR before the review. :wave:
